description:
Add the result-bundle fields the ADR defines so every later item has somewhere to record requested, applied and observed values, and so old bundles map onto the new fields.

Work:
1. Schema 2.3 (additive): CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION and KNOWN_SCHEMA_V2_VERSIONS in benchbox/core/results/schema_policy.py; key order in core/results/schema_specs.yaml for config.execution_engine, platform.execution_engine, queries[].execution_engine, platform.compute.{resource, resource_kind, size}, platform.gateway, platform.deployment.{selected, selected_class} (fields stay absent until a producer fills them).
2. Builder plumbing: RunConfigInput carries execution_engine (core/results/builder.py); platform.execution_engine is taken from the adapter's resolve_execution_engine receipt as returned in get_platform_info()["execution_engine"] (core/results/schema.py _build_platform_section).
3. platform.variant (unused today, core/results/schema.py:215,469) holds the variant_id string (for example polars-df+streaming) computed by one core function derive_variant_id(platform, deployment, requested_engine, gateway) per ADR D8. Display labels ("Polars (streaming)") are derived separately by the Explorer item and are not stored here.
4. Legacy mapping in the loader: a 2.2 bundle reads as requested=default with applied/observed unknown; platform_options.streaming=true maps to requested=streaming with resolution=legacy_option; platform.config.engine_requested (the Polars matrix bundles) maps to requested with resolution=explicit, except `default`, which maps to resolution=version_default.
5. Anonymizer (anonymization_specs.yaml, anonymization.py) per ADR D7: core vocabulary keys stay readable; compute_resource follows the D7 decision (drop or hash); gateway host goes with endpoint keys. Keep the Polars `engine` exemption until core-exec-polars-cli-mcp-adoption removes the option.
6. docs/reference/result-formats.md version table and field reference; CHANGELOG [Unreleased] entry for schema 2.3.
